description: Selection-set policy applied uniformly by generate_provider.mjs. The query text and the responses.200 schema are generated from the same resolved field list. Never hand-tuned per resource.

rules.scalarAndEnumFields: select every field on the node type whose named type is a scalar or an enum, including lists of scalars/enums (projected as JSON arrays)
rules.excludeFieldsWithRequiredArgs: fields that declare one or more required arguments are not selectable bare and are excluded
rules.nestedIdentity: for each node-type field named in nestedIdentityAllowlist whose type is a single (non-list) object, select the intersection of the allowlisted subfields that exist on that object type as scalars/enums
